sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed how the Public Transport Authority handled an allegation of excessive force during a transit arrest.
sentences.support:
the Commission 
decided to conduct a review of the action taken by the PTA.

sentences.text: The review examined local incident handling, internal scrutiny and wider controls over transit officers’ use of force.
sentences.support:
The Commission reviewed the actions taken by the PTA, including the local 
management by the Security Services Branch

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the Authority’s response was inadequate and that more force had been used than the arrest required.
sentences.support: The Commission considers the action taken by the PTA to be inadequate.

sentences.text: The Commission made one recommendation to revise use of force procedures, covering oversight, policy breaches and the legal and policy basis for force.
sentences.support:
Review, update, and implement policies and procedures associated 
with managing use of force incidents

findings.quote:
The actions taken by the PTA failed to demonstrate a comprehensive and 
transparent investigation of the incident.

All use of force incidents should be thoroughly scrutinised to ensure a 
Transit Officer's actions are lawful, appropriate, and reasonable in the 
circumstances.

notes: One main recommendation has three specified requirements; the report also uses “recommendations” in the plural. The review concerns the Authority’s response and does not substitute a disciplinary finding.
